Giant Spider (CV 15)

A dog-sized hunting spider with a swollen abdomen, hooked feet and pale silk glands beneath its jaws. Its web is both a trap and an extension of its senses.

HP: 16 · Speed: Ground 6; climb 6 · Footprint: 1x1

Summoned form — player reference.

Defense modifier: 1 Boon. · Stability: 0.

DR / resistance: None · Condition immunities: None

Weakness: None

Healing: Summoned energy form: cannot be healed; disappears at 0 HP without leaving a body.

Senses: Ordinary sight and hearing.

Communication: None

Attributes: Brawn +1; Fortitude +1; Agility +2; Guile +0; Knowledge -2; Reason +1

Eligibility: Animal 3

Main command: Main + Maneuver; Maneuver command: Maneuver + movement. One command per summon per controller turn; immediate summoning command counts. No activity or alerts without a command; no Reactions or opportunity attacks. Turn ticks use controller’s turn. Beyond 6 squares, or controller unconscious/dead, it disappears; at 0 HP it disappears. No permanent loot.

Carrying: up to 1 Bulk; anatomy limits handling. No granted crafting training.

Roll its printed attack attribute and read the attacker outcomes below. When it is attacked, roll the defense attribute named by the incoming attack. Passive defenses remain; no independent active effects.

Attacks — Main Action

AttackAttributeAttack modifierWeak attackStandard attackStrong attack
Venomous fangsBrawnNone2 physical damage.4 physical damage. Poisoned 1.6 physical damage. Poisoned 2.
Web castAgilityNoneNo damage. Slowed 1.No damage. Slowed 2.No damage. Slowed 3.

Venomous fangs: One adjacent creature.

Web cast: One visible creature within 5 squares. An adjacent helper or the target may spend Main to remove 1 of this Slowed. Fire damage to the target removes all of this web’s Slowed after damage resolves. Otherwise decay normally.

Maneuvers

Silken Scuttle — Maneuver

Its feet drum across its own silk, drawing the whole web tight as it changes its hunting angle.

Move up to 3 squares along existing web on a supporting surface, using its printed movement modes, without provoking from one visible enemy chosen before moving. Treat those web-covered squares as normal terrain for this movement only. Other opportunities apply. It cannot create a bridge, cross an occupied square or carry a grappled creature through this movement.

Use only as part of a command; no independent activity.

Defend — Maneuver: gain 1 Boon to defenses until the start of the controller’s next turn; repeated Defend does not stack.

Basic Melee — Main: None to attack; Brawn, one adjacent target; Weak attack 2, Standard 3, Strong 5 physical damage. No specialty riders. No opportunity Reaction.
